bubble-android.description:
Read any app, game, comic or chat in your own language without leaving it. Bubble translates text right on your screen (31 languages, offline once downloaded), copies text that can't normally be selected, opens on-screen QR codes and sends anything you crop to Google Lens, Yandex or TinEye. Hold Home to open it: no root, no recording popup, and it stays off in banking apps.

Lightweight, privacy-first Android live screen translator (31 offline ML Kit languages), custom Tesseract 5 OCR, full-screen text selector, auto QR/QRIS scanner & multi-engine visual search (Google Lens, Yandex, TinEye). Runs silently via Default Digital Assistant without root or recording popups, with Safe Mode & bilingual EN/ID UI.
